description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Any web page as clean, LLM-ready Markdown text with navigation, ads and boilerplate stripped: title, text and character count. Example: url=https://example.com. No charge if the page cannot be fetched. Returns JSON title, clean Markdown text, and character count for the page.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

url.description: Absolute page URL. Format: https:// host and path. Example: https://example.com. Required.

name: scrape_text
title: Page to clean text ($0.003)
